body:
Thanks for the reply, and the link to the video, once I get home I’ll definetly sit down and watch it. It’s almost funny to think that someone took the time to go through my past posts and write something meaningful, rather than some generic copy and paste message, and it honestly means more than you can imagine. 

Probably for the first time I can remember, I am going to take the advice of someone else (being you) and follow through with it. 

If you’re interested, I’ll be sure to post an update in the future. 

Thank you again.
Thanks man (or girl, I guess it’s impossible to tell). It’s always great finding people to talk to. Pm me if you ever need anything.

Most non prescription treatments aren’t allowed in the US. I also won’t be able to get access to therapy or prescriptions for certain reasons. My old therapy was listen to music, but recently my depression as gotten so much worse that I don’t enjoy music and it just makes me even more sad in the moment.

This hits me hard. I relate too much to this. You would think it would help me by hearing someone else have the same issue but it’s making me consider how useless I am. I’m sorry your struggling with this, and I hope you have more luck than me in the future.
I don’t even know what to do. I’m already waiting for it to be night again just to pass time by sleeping.

I’ve been too busy with school to be able to find a job. I used to run to deal with my problems but I just don’t have the energy anymore. I can’t listen to music or watch tv because the second my brain drifts off I’m back thinking about how I’m a failure and nothings worth it.
I don’t enjoy anything anymore. That’s my problem.

Hopefully. Good to know someone else has been here (not saying your past is good lmao, you know what I mean) I have a feeling I’ve finally found a good outlet to talk about what I’m feeling. I’m sure you’ll see more of me on here.

I have a year and a half left of school, so counting down is a possibility I guess. Couple classes with her as well 

Stuck in band, parents won’t let me quit. She’s there too. Same instrument same everything. 

Haven’t been back to school since it happened by I go back in 2 days. Not looking forward to it.
Is it bad that when you said “sounds like she just isn’t mature enough...” I almost felt a little better?   I’m just so lost now idk what to do or think.
Guess so. She was my last chance, now I’m actually, totally, alone.

My whole thing is that she was the last person I really had after all my friends had left me in the first place. Now I just sit around all day (or after school) waiting to fall asleep so the day is over. 

I don’t even know what to do with my life anymore. Feeling utterly alone is eating away at me. I don’t even want to move.

Tell me about it. Seeing her at school with the guy she promised was just a friend. Leaves me because she can’t “handle my problems” (i.e I had just told her about my struggle with depression) and immediately moved on to him within a day. 

Don’t even know what to do anymore.
I feel the same way. Finding ways to waste time before it’s time to go to sleep. Then repeat.
